::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** April 18th 1885  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne,Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Harry Ransom Humanities Resource Center, University of Texas at Austin
:::

Dear [Mr Coleridge](people/person_336.qmd)

Thank you much for kindly remembering me on this occasion but I do not think I shall be in London at the time.[^1]

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: CMY is declining an invitation to Westminster Abbey to witness the unveiling by James Russell Lowell of a bust of [Samuel Taylor Coleridge](people/person_1667.qmd) on 7 May 1885.
